# Toilet Plus — full LLM reference

All plumbing services, lots of plumber connections. Toilet Plus is an agentic, two-sided
plumbing platform: homeowners book a licensed local plumber in minutes through "Plus" (an
AI dispatcher), and plumbing businesses run their entire operation — leads, jobs,
scheduling, flat-rate pricing, payments — on a multi-tenant SaaS with an embedded AI
copilot and a job/lead marketplace for subcontracting.

Brand voice: friend-speak (a straight-talking neighbor), never marketing-speak. Short
sentences, contractions, honest reads. Upfront flat-rate pricing, 24/7, licensed/bonded/
insured (Lic. #PL-48217). No hype, no emoji, no scare tactics. SEO/LSI plumbing terms used
naturally: drain cleaning, hydro-jetting, clogged/slow drain, snake the line, sewer
lateral, main line backup, water heater repair, tankless, leak detection, slab leak,
pinhole leak, burst pipe, repipe, galvanized pipe, water pressure, sump pump, garbage
disposal, P-trap, flange, fixture, emergency plumber, same-day.

================================================================================
HOMEOWNER FUNNEL  (/get-started)
================================================================================
A structured conversation run by the AI dispatcher "Plus". Five steps:

1. COVERAGE — homeowner enters ZIP. System confirms service area and routes the nearest
   licensed crew (e.g. 98107 → Ballard → Sam R.'s crew, truck TP-07, ★4.9).
2. INTAKE — "What's going on?" Options: clogged/slow drain · no hot water · leak/burst
   pipe · sewer/main backup · toilet/faucet/fixture · something else (free text).
3. DIAGNOSTIC + TRIAGE — one smart follow-up per problem; result sets urgency:
   emergency | urgent | today | soon. Examples:
     - Leak "actively running, can't stop" → emergency (priority dispatch).
     - Water heater "pooling at base" → urgent.
     - One sink clog → soon.
4. QUOTE + SCHEDULE — a flat-rate estimate range is shown (from the pricebook, below),
   then real windows with the assigned plumber and ETA. Soonest window is highlighted.
5. CONFIRM — name + mobile. System books the job, sends a confirmation text, schedules an
   ETA text at roll-out, and a follow-up/review request after. A live "Job Ticket"
   (#TP-####) summarizes location, service, details, plumber, window, estimate, contact.

FLAT-RATE PRICEBOOK (estimate ranges; final set on site, approved before work):
  - Drain cleaning ............ $149–$325  (free camera look; hydro-jetting quoted on site)
  - Water heater repair ....... $185–$480  (replacement quoted on site, sized right)
  - Leak detection & repair ... $165–$390  (slab/behind-wall quoted after locate)
  - Sewer / main line clear ... $199–$450  (+ camera inspection; root/repair quoted)
  - Fixtures & toilets ........ $129–$280  (per fixture; parts shown before install)
  - Other ..................... quoted on site, always before any work

================================================================================
OPERATOR PLATFORM  (Toilet Plus Pro, /pro)
================================================================================
Multi-tenant SaaS for plumbing businesses. Each tenant (a plumbing company) gets:
  - JOBS PIPELINE — board: new → scheduled → in_progress → invoiced → paid.
  - DISPATCH BOARD — plumbers × time; drag-assign, route by proximity.
  - JOB DETAIL — timeline, photos, quote, invoice, AI notes.
  - CUSTOMER RECORDS — history, equipment, prior visits.
  - PRICEBOOK — flat-rate service catalog (drives both quotes and homeowner estimates).
  - PAYMENTS & INVOICES — draft/send invoices, take card/ACH, chase unpaid balances.
  - REPORTS — revenue, close rate, avg ticket, first-time-fix, review score.
  - AI COPILOT — chat + suggested actions: daily briefing, dispatch suggestions, auto-quote
    drafts, comms drafts, "who should take this lead" recommendations.

MARKETPLACE / SUBCONTRACTING (/pro/marketplace):
  - Leads and overflow jobs can be posted to, or claimed from, the marketplace.
  - Billing models: pay-per-lead and pay-per-job. Agency-style oversight lets a parent
    org organize sub-contractors, set rules, and audit fulfillment for both the homeowner
    and the plumber side.

FIELD APP (/pro/app): today's route, on-site flat-rate quote builder, photos, collect
payment, mark complete — optimized for one-handed use in the field.

================================================================================
AGENT GUARDRAILS (summary — full text in agentic.md)
================================================================================
  - Confirm before committing: booking, invoicing, charging, or claiming a paid lead needs
    an explicit human "yes" in-session.
  - Never quote outside the pricebook; estimates are ranges; final shown before work.
  - Emergencies escalate immediately to (555) 240-7867 — don't bury behind a form.
  - Only assign licensed/insured/background-checked plumbers; surface Lic. #PL-48217.
  - Collect only ZIP, problem, name, mobile to book. No spam, no PII sale.

TOOLS (machine-readable: agentic/tools.mcp.json, .well-known/ai-plugin.json):
  lookup_coverage(zip) · run_intake(problem) · triage_urgency(intake) ·
  get_quote(service, details) · get_slots(zip, urgency) · create_booking(...) ·
  send_message(channel, to, template) · list_jobs(tenant, filter) · claim_lead(lead_id) ·
  create_invoice(job_id, lines) · take_payment(invoice_id, method)

CONTACT: (555) 240-7867 · 24/7 · metro + ~30 mi.
